saas_subs_one_trial_per_milkman.name: saas_subs_one_trial_per_milkman
saas_subs_one_trial_per_milkman.where: status = 'TRIAL' or (plan_id is null and status <> 'CANCELLED')

milk_plans_one_price.name: milk_plans_one_price
milk_plans_one_price.value:
("app"."milk_plans"."price_per_delivery" is not null and "app"."milk_plans"."monthly_price" is null)
       or ("app"."milk_plans"."price_per_delivery" is null and "app"."milk_plans"."monthly_price" is not null)

generated.as:
case when status = 'DELIVERED'
               then round(coalesce(delivered_quantity, 0) * unit_price, 2)
               else 0 end

deliveries_quantities_non_negative.name: deliveries_quantities_non_negative
deliveries_quantities_non_negative.value:
"app"."deliveries"."planned_quantity" >= 0
      and ("app"."deliveries"."adjusted_quantity" is null or "app"."deliveries"."adjusted_quantity" >= 0)
      and ("app"."deliveries"."delivered_quantity" is null or "app"."deliveries"."delivered_quantity" >= 0)

deliveries_quantity_ceiling.name: deliveries_quantity_ceiling
deliveries_quantity_ceiling.value:
"app"."deliveries"."planned_quantity" <= 100
      and ("app"."deliveries"."adjusted_quantity" is null or "app"."deliveries"."adjusted_quantity" <= 100)
      and ("app"."deliveries"."delivered_quantity" is null or "app"."deliveries"."delivered_quantity" <= 100)

deliveries_delivered_consistency.name: deliveries_delivered_consistency
deliveries_delivered_consistency.value:
("app"."deliveries"."status" = 'DELIVERED'
           and "app"."deliveries"."delivered_quantity" is not null
           and "app"."deliveries"."delivered_at" is not null)
       or ("app"."deliveries"."status" <> 'DELIVERED' and "app"."deliveries"."delivered_quantity" is null)

notifications_unread_idx.name: notifications_unread_idx
notifications_unread_idx.where: read_at is null and archived_at is null
